title: Overview
form.name: Project name
form.question: Initial research question
form.duplicate: An Active project already has this name. You can still create it, but a different name is easier to tell apart.
form.afterCreate: After creating, Project AI Chat opens to clarify the context and propose a Plan. The LaTeX manuscript is set up later in Manuscript.
form.notCreated: no project was created; the form keeps what you typed.
form.retryHint: Press “Create and open chat” again; a retry does not create a second project.
edit.title: Edit project details
edit.archivedReadOnly: This project is Archived and read-only. Reopen it to edit.
edit.conflict: The project was changed elsewhere. The newer version is loaded; what you typed is kept, press Save to apply it to the newer version.
archive.title: Archive “{{name}}”?
archive.consequence: The project becomes Archived and read-only. Its open pending actions become Expired. Trusted References are not affected. You can reopen it at any time.
archive.blocked: Cannot archive: the project still has an active workflow.
delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.consequence: The project is hidden from every area, search and agent context.
delete.data: To be deleted: Plan, Tasks, evidence, artifacts, manuscript, chat history. Trusted References are not affected.
delete.window: Restorable for {{days}} days from the Deleted tab; permanent deletion expected on {{date}}.
delete.blocked: Cannot delete: the project still has an active workflow.
blocked.next: Nothing changed. Cancel or wait for the workflows below to end in Agent Activity, then try again.
notice.archived: Archived “{{name}}”. It is in the Archived tab.
notice.deleted: Deleted “{{name}}”. Restorable for 30 days from the Deleted tab.
projects.title: Research Projects
projects.filterEmptyReason: The filter only looks at names and short descriptions of loaded projects.
projects.empty.deleted: No project deleted in the last 30 days
projects.emptyReason.Active: Create your first project: SIRes opens Project AI Chat to clarify the topic and propose a Plan.
projects.emptyReason.Archived: Projects archived from the Active tab show here, read-only.
projects.emptyReason.deleted: Deleted projects stay here for 30 days so you can restore them.
projects.menuNote: Row actions: Open · Edit details · Archive (read-only, open prompts become Expired) · Delete (restorable within 30 days).
dashboard.apiKey.title: Add your API key so the agents can work
dashboard.apiKey.detail: SIRes has no default key or quota. OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini are supported.

dashboard.recovery.detailMany: Outputs of finished steps are kept. Each workflow needs a Recovery decision.
